notes: Programmatic catalog-valid pack. Regenerate with XAI via npm run generate:season-prompts when XAI_API_KEY is set.

prompts.title: URL Shortener at Scale
prompts.summary: Design a bit.ly-style shortener with hash codes, cache, and a scale path.
prompts.description: Users create short codes from long URLs; redirects must be very fast. Cover code generation, collision handling, caching, and sharding of the mapping store.
requirements: Create short URLs (hash or ID encoding)
Explain DB schema and scale path
prompts.rationale: Edge + LB for latency and scale; Redis absorbs redirect reads; SQL holds durable mappings with a clear hash partition path.

prompts.title: Distributed Key-Value Store
prompts.summary: Dynamo-style KV with consistent hashing and replication.
prompts.description: Design a key-value store: partition with consistent hashing, replicate for durability, support get/put under partition risk.
prompts.rationale: Gateway fronts a KV store configured for consistent hashing and multi-AZ replication; monitoring tracks hot partitions.

prompts.title: Distributed Rate Limiter
prompts.summary: Shared rate limits across gateway fleet with low added latency.
prompts.description: Gateways call a limiter for per-user or per-IP quotas. Limits must be shared across instances without becoming a bottleneck.
requirements: Degrade gracefully if store is down
prompts.rationale: Rate limiter with Redis cluster state keeps checks fast and sharded by key; gateway enforces before app work.

prompts.title: Real-time Chat System
prompts.summary: 1:1 and group chat with presence, fan-out, and message history.
prompts.description: Design messaging with low-latency delivery, offline inbox, and scalable group fan-out.
prompts.rationale: Gateway + chat service with async fan-out queue, durable wide-column history, and cache for presence.

prompts.title: News Feed / Timeline
prompts.summary: Fan-out on write/read hybrid feed for social timeline.
prompts.description: Users post and follow others; home timeline must stay fast as graph and write volume grow.
prompts.rationale: Hybrid fan-out: workers precompute timelines into cache; SQL holds durable posts sharded by user.

prompts.title: Global Unique ID Generator
prompts.summary: High-throughput globally unique IDs with rough time ordering.
prompts.description: Services need unique 64-bit IDs at high QPS without a single coordinator bottleneck.
prompts.rationale: Stateless ID nodes with leased worker bits (Snowflake-style) avoid a single sequence bottleneck.

prompts.title: Ride Sharing Dispatch
prompts.summary: Match riders to nearby drivers with geo indexing and realtime updates.
prompts.description: Design dispatch: location updates, nearby search, matching, trip state, and surge-friendly scale.
prompts.rationale: Location stream updates a geo index; SQL holds trip lifecycle; queue notifies parties asynchronously.

prompts.title: Video Streaming Platform
prompts.summary: Upload, transcode, and CDN-deliver adaptive bitrate video.
prompts.description: Users upload videos; system processes encodings and serves ABR streams globally with low startup latency.
prompts.rationale: Object storage + async workers for encode; CDN for global ABR; SQL/search for catalog.

prompts.title: Payment Processing
prompts.summary: Idempotent payments with ledger, retries, and auditability.
prompts.description: Design charge/refund flows with strong correctness, idempotency keys, and reconciliation.
prompts.rationale: Sync multi-AZ SQL ledger for money correctness; async queue for webhooks; secrets and audit logging for compliance.

prompts.title: Multi-tenant SaaS Data Plane
prompts.summary: Isolate tenants while sharing infra efficiently.
prompts.description: Design storage and compute isolation for a B2B SaaS with noisy-neighbor controls and per-tenant config.
prompts.rationale: Tenant_id sharding + directory for whales, gateway rate limits, and auth boundary enforce isolation.

prompts.title: Product Search Service
prompts.summary: Low-latency product search with indexing pipeline.
prompts.description: Index catalog updates and serve ranked search with filters and autocomplete.
prompts.rationale: Query path hits search index (+ cache); async workers keep index fresh from DB change events.

prompts.title: Global Static Asset Delivery
prompts.summary: Serve static assets with CDN, cache headers, and origin shield.
prompts.description: Design delivery for JS/CSS/images with high hit ratio and controlled invalidation.
prompts.rationale: DNS → CDN for edge hits; WAF-protected object origin for misses; versioned assets simplify invalidation.

prompts.title: Observability for Microservices
prompts.summary: Metrics, logs, and traces for a microservice fleet.
prompts.description: Design an observability stack: RED/USE metrics, structured logs, distributed traces, and alert routing.
prompts.rationale: Three pillars with TSDB for metrics and object storage for log retention; pubsub for async event export.

prompts.title: Async Notification Pipeline
prompts.summary: Decouple user actions from email/SMS delivery with retries and DLQ.
prompts.description: After signup or order events, send notifications reliably without blocking the request path.
requirements: Async queue between API and workers
prompts.rationale: API enqueues; workers send with DLQ-backed queue; monitoring tracks lag and failures.

prompts.title: RAG Support Agent
prompts.summary: Customer support agent grounded on a knowledge base with span evals.
prompts.description: Design an agent that answers support questions using RAG, tool loops, and quality measurement.
prompts.rationale: Agent loops LLM + RAG over a vector index with embeddings; guardrails and span evals close the quality loop.

prompts.title: Web Research Agent
prompts.summary: Multi-step research with web search and synthesis.
prompts.description: Agent plans queries, searches the web, stores notes, and produces a sourced brief.
prompts.rationale: Orchestrator runs a researcher agent with web search + memory; traces capture each tool step.

prompts.title: Parallel Multi-Agent Research Team
prompts.summary: Fan-out specialists then synthesize with a lead agent.
prompts.description: Design a team: planner, parallel researchers, critic, and merger with shared memory and evals.
prompts.rationale: Team + parallel fan-out runs specialists concurrently into shared memory; e2e evals gate quality.

prompts.title: Coding Agent for PRs
prompts.summary: Agent that edits code with sandboxed exec and human review gates.
prompts.description: Design an agent that plans changes, edits files, runs tests in a sandbox, and opens a PR with human approval for risky steps.
prompts.rationale: Coder agent loops on sandboxed exec + git tools; human review gates merge; prompt registry + span evals track quality.

prompts.title: Enterprise Agent Platform
prompts.summary: Multi-tenant agent platform with routing, guardrails, and observability.
prompts.description: Platform teams host many internal agents: model routing, tool permissions, tenancy, traces, and eval gates before deploy.
prompts.rationale: Router + auth tenancy, guardrails on agent I/O, traces, and e2e eval gates before prompt/model deploys.

prompts.title: Eval-Driven Agent Improvement
prompts.summary: Close the loop: traces → span/e2e evals → prompt changes.
prompts.description: Design how a team measures agent quality, finds regressions, and safely ships prompt/model updates.
prompts.rationale: Traces feed span + e2e evals; results drive prompt registry versions with orchestrated human-gated rollout.
